# Users.au Laravel Client

> Laravel OAuth 2.0 / SSO client for Users.au: login, registration, callback and logout routes and local user synchronization. Composer package `users-au/laravel-client`. Part of Users.au (https://www.users.au), a hosted identity service.

Install / start: `composer require users-au/laravel-client`

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/Users-au/laravel-client/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, usage, troubleshooting and FAQ
- [Users.au](https://www.users.au): hosted authentication service
- [Users.au console](https://my.users.au): create a project and an OAuth application

## Related projects
- [Laravel starter kit](https://github.com/Users-au/laravel-starter-kit)
- [Next.js starter kit](https://github.com/Users-au/nextjs-starter-kit)
- [Laravel Socialite provider (Composer)](https://github.com/Users-au/socialite-provider)
- [Frontend client (npm)](https://github.com/Users-au/frontend-client)
